response.overview: Asia and her man are busy reporters for the country's top gossip rag. They're respected and admired... especially by their hard-driving boss.  Who might just be a cold-blooded murderer.  Join the acclaimed new director Austin Ellison in his important new film Scandal, featuring the scandalous and beautiful Asia Carrera, with a supporting cast of vixens long enough to fill a masthead.  Pick up Scandal, the DVD. As current as an Elvis sighting. And as outrageous.
response.title: Scandal
